parts.t: Rare small-bay industrial opportunity in a sought-after Cloverdale location! Offering 1,849 sqft. of usable space, including 1,153 sqft. on the main floor plus a 696 sqft. mezzanine. The versatile layout features high ceilings, a large grade-level bay door, and flexible warehouse, storage, and office space. IL zoning allows for a wide range of potential uses including trades, service businesses, light manufacturing, warehousing, and automotive-related operations. Centrally located with excellent access and currently used for storage. Well-sized industrial units like this are increasingly hard to find!

v: Cable Connected, Electricity Connected, Natural Gas Connected, Phone Connected
